title: itembank report payloads
description: Two shapes, selected by which fields are present: a session summary (from 'itembank report' and runtime.session_summary()) and an objective history (from 'itembank evidence --objective' and evidence.objective_history()). Every count in either shape is post-retraction -- a raw line count of the evidence log overstates history, because D-10 undoes a response by appending a compensating event rather than removing anything.

auto_attempts.description: Count of responses with a non-null score

pending_manual.description: Count of constructed responses awaiting a mark

objectives.description: Objective name to {attempts, correct, pending}, unmapped responses grouped under the literal key '(unmapped)'

teaching_outcomes.description: Per-item teaching outcomes (D-17, TEACH-03, Phase 6) keyed by the stable item identity (opaque [ID:] when assigned, else 'ref:<positional id>'), derived from live response/hint/mark events by evidence.teaching_outcomes() -- never from a mutable counter. Optional: a summary written before plan 06-01 (or by a caller that has not yet joined live evidence) has none.

correct_after_attempts.description: Total genuine attempts through the first correct response, or null when no correct response exists.

correct_after_tier.description: Same as correct_after_attempts when at least one hint had been shown, else null -- two otherwise-identical correct responses at tier 1 and tier 4 must produce different rows (TEACH-03).

stumped_at_tier.description: The lowest tier at which the learner used the stumped control, or null when they never did. Stumped is not a wrong response.

revealed.description: True when the authored reveal (tier 5) was shown.

hints_used.description: Number of live hint events for this item -- never a mutable counter.

highest_tier.description: Highest tier shown, or null when no tier was shown.

bank.description: Plan 07-03. The bank basename this query was scoped to, or "" when no --bank filter was given. Optional: a document written before phase 7 has none.

retracted.description: How many of this query's response events are suppressed by a retraction (plan 01-07). count is already post-retraction; this says how much of the raw log for this query was undone, so a smaller count is never mistaken for missing data. Optional: a document written before plan 01-07 has none.

by_mode.description: Plan 01-08, EVID-08's visible half. Mode name to {attempts, correct, wrong, pending}, counted over this query's events alone -- a drill-mode correct and an exam-mode correct live in different keys and are never summed into one figure. Optional: a document written before plan 01-08 has none.

index.description: Plan 01-08, D-08. Whether the disposable sqlite3 projection answered this query ("used") or could not be built/extended at all, so a full log scan answered it instead ("fallback"). Either way the answer is the same; this field only says which path produced it. Optional: a document written before plan 01-08 has none.

index_rebuilt.description: Plan 01-08. True when --rebuild-index deleted and rebuilt the projection before this query ran. The index is a cache (D-08); rebuilding it costs time and loses nothing. Optional: a document written before plan 01-08 has none.

objective.description: The recorded objective of the response this row projects (plan 07-03). A document written before phase 7 has none.

bank.description: The recorded bank basename of the response this row projects (plan 07-03, D-13). A document written before phase 7 has none.

snapshot_id.description: Opaque deterministic id of the one immutable evidence snapshot every claim in this report derives from (D-01).

cutoff.description: ISO-8601 UTC cutoff timestamp of the capture.

local_day_zone.description: The local-day zone policy (UTC, local, fixed offset, or IANA name) that every date-derived signal used.

filters.description: The objective/subject/bank filters this report was derived under, named so a filtered claim is never mistaken for an unfiltered one (D-15).

settings_version.description: Content hash of the retention settings this snapshot was derived under.

accuracy.description: Raw correct/settled rate; null when there is no settled evidence (D-03), never zero.

recent_accuracy.description: Accuracy over the most recent min_settled_attempts settled outcomes; null when none exist.

highest_hint.description: Highest Phase 6 hint tier recorded for this objective; null when no hint was ever used.

last_evidence.description: ISO local date of the most recent live response event; null with no evidence.

risk_reason.description: Evidence-anchored reason for the state, or null for unknown/stable (D-14: at-risk names last proven success and silence).

weeks.description: Per-bucket (1w/2w/4w/8w/12w) longitudinal series with raw counts beside rates.

scheduler.description: Derived scheduler state (strategy, interval, due date, stage) replayed from the log, or null with no reviews (D-17/D-18/D-19).

schema_version.description: The retention report variant (Phase 10); the session-summary and objective-history variants keep schema_version 1.

states.description: State name to objective count; absent states are simply not keys.

objectives.description: Objective name to retention_objective_row; only objectives with captured evidence appear.

weights.description: Objective name to bounded normalized weight with named components and snapshot id (D-11/D-12).

rate.description: occurred/due with the denominator stated; null when there were no due sittings (D-20, D-03).
